## Raise Work Order

Ad-hoc work order creation — the corrective / inspection / project path that isn't driven by a Maintenance Plan (those come from Generate PM Work Orders instead, which sets `planDueKey`). Requires either a subject asset or a subject location; refuses a work order about nothing.

### Non-goals

Not the generator's entry point — a plan-driven PM work order never goes through this command.
